fieldValues.title: Group / organisation
fieldValues.summary: People working together as a group that owns its own meaning (a specific case of "People working together") and wants it to stay portable.
jobs: Record decisions and the reasons for them
Keep a shared vocabulary stable over time
Let members and agents contribute with attribution
Move its records to another tool
Show outsiders what it has decided
fieldValues.needs: An open format, and no lock-in to one app or AI vendor.
